Calibration log

Source: R/project_entries.R
calibration_log.Rd

A calibration project is a folder holding an append-only, tamper-evident record of a calibration: who did what, when, with which data and parameters, and why. Each function below writes one entry; none edits or deletes an earlier one.

Usage

start_calibration_project(
  path,
  catchment,
  gauge,
  purpose,
  area_km2,
  owner,
  steward,
  description = "",
  id = basename(path)
)

register_data(
  project,
  forcing,
  observed,
  calibration,
  validation = NULL,
  headline = "nse",
  log_offset = 0.01,
  soil_fraction = 0.5,
  copy = TRUE,
  reasoning = "",
  thresholds = NULL,
  rating = NULL,
  event_tolerance_h = 6,
  event_gap_h = 24,
  event_min_duration_h = 0,
  test = NULL
)

select_structure(project, configuration, reasoning)

preview_trial(project, parent, changes)

log_trial(project, parent, changes, verdict, reasoning)

log_auto_calibration(
  project,
  parent,
  lower,
  upper,
  objective = c("nse", "rmse", "log_rmse", "threshold"),
  starts = 1L,
  seed = NULL,
  control = list(maxit = 200),
  reasoning,
  method = c("lbfgsb", "nelder_mead"),
  threshold_objective = NULL,
  threshold_weight = 1,
  threshold_score = "csi",
  log_scale = character(0)
)

log_note(project, text, refers_to = NULL)

propose_candidate(project, entry, reasoning)

validate_candidate(project, reasoning)

test_candidate(project, reasoning)

sign_off_project(
  project,
  statement,
  checklist = c(integrity = FALSE, data = FALSE, calibration_path = FALSE, validation =
    FALSE)
)

reopen_project(project, reason)

Arguments

path

Folder to create for a new project; it must not exist or must be empty.

catchment, gauge, purpose

Catchment name, gauge identifier (for example an NRFA station number) and the purpose of the calibration.

area_km2

Catchment area, km2. Every configuration must use it.

owner, steward

Names of the accountable Owner and the Steward expected to sign off.

description

Optional free text.

id

Project identifier; defaults to the folder name.

project

Path of the project folder.

forcing

Path of a CSV file, or a data frame, with rain and pet in mm per interval and an optional time column.

observed

Path of a CSV file with a q_m3s column, a data frame, or a numeric vector of observed flow, m3/s, aligned with forcing. Missing values are allowed.

calibration, validation, test

Scoring windows as c(start, end): row numbers, or times when the forcing has a time column. Rows before the calibration window are warm-up. validation may be NULL until it is needed. test is an optional final window, scored once by test_candidate() after every choice is made, and by nothing else; the three windows must not overlap.

headline

Score used to rank runs: one of nse, log_nse, kge, rmse, log_rmse, abs_volume_error, or a threshold score written as metric:name, such as csi:Flood Warning, where metric is pod, far, csi, pod_step, far_step, csi_step, ets_step or pss_step.

log_offset

Offset added before logarithms, m3/s.

soil_fraction

Initial soil store as a fraction of capacity for every run.

copy

If TRUE, files are copied into the project; if FALSE they are referenced by path and MD5. Data frames and vectors are always written into the project.

reasoning, statement, reason, text

Free text explaining the entry.

thresholds

Optional data frame of thresholds with columns name, value and unit: flow (m3/s) or level (m, converted to flow through rating). Every run is then also scored with pdm_threshold_scores(), under names such as csi:Flood Warning.

rating

Rating table for level thresholds: a CSV path or data frame with stage_m and q_m3s. Levels outside it are refused, not extrapolated. Stored like the data.

event_tolerance_h, event_gap_h, event_min_duration_h

Event matching settings in hours; see pdm_threshold_scores().

configuration

A configuration list or the path of a YAML configuration file.

parent

Id of the structure, trial or automatic calibration entry to start from.

changes

Named numeric vector of new values, named by configuration path such as surface.k1 or fc.

verdict

Your judgement of the trial: better, worse or inconclusive.

lower, upper, objective, starts, seed, control, method, log_scale

Passed to calibrate_pdm().

threshold_objective

Optional names of registered thresholds to include in the objective of an automatic calibration, with method = "nelder_mead". Their flows and the registered event settings are used, so the calibration and the scorecard agree.

threshold_weight, threshold_score

Weight and score of the threshold term; see calibrate_pdm().

refers_to

Optional id of the entry a note concerns.

entry

Id of the structure, trial or automatic calibration proposed as candidate.

checklist

Named logical vector confirming the Steward reviewed integrity, data, calibration_path and validation; all must be TRUE.

Value

The new entry as a list, invisibly. preview_trial() writes nothing and returns the configuration, scores and series of the proposed trial.

Details

FunctionEntryRole
start_calibration_project()project_startCustodian
register_data()data_registeredCustodian
select_structure()structure_selectedCustodian
log_trial()trialCustodian
log_auto_calibration()auto_calibrationCustodian
log_note()noteAny
propose_candidate()candidateCustodian
validate_candidate()validationCustodian
test_candidate()testCustodian
sign_off_project()sign_offSteward or Delegated Steward
reopen_project()reopenSteward or Delegated Steward

Declare who you are once per session, with options(pdmS7.user = "Your Name", pdmS7.role = "custodian"), or with the environment variables PDMS7_USER and PDMS7_ROLE. Every entry records the name, the role and the operating-system login. A Steward cannot sign off a project in which they wrote a trial, automatic calibration, candidate or validation.

Every run simulates the whole registered record from initial_state(model, soil_fraction). Trials and automatic calibrations are scored on the calibration window only; the validation window is scored once, by validate_candidate(), and an optional test window once more, by test_candidate(), after every choice is made. See pdm_scorecard() for the scores and verify_project() for the integrity checks.

Examples

folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "example-project")
old <- options(pdmS7.user = "A Hydrologist", pdmS7.role = "custodian")
start_calibration_project(folder, catchment = "Example", gauge = "00000",
  purpose = "Illustration", area_km2 = 50, owner = "Deputy Director",
  steward = "A Steward")
#> INFO [2026-11-01 19:37:01] Started calibration project example-project in /tmp/Rtmp3FiuoL/example-project
set.seed(1)
forcing <- data.frame(rain = ifelse(runif(500) < 0.1, rexp(500, 0.3), 0), pet = 0.1)
truth <- pdm_presets("standard")
truth$area_km2 <- 50
observed <- run_pdm(pdm_from_config(truth), forcing)$output$q_m3s
register_data(folder, forcing, observed, calibration = c(101, 350),
  validation = c(351, 500))
#> INFO [2026-11-01 19:37:01] Registered data 0002: 500 rows
select_structure(folder, truth, reasoning = "Standard structure as a starting point")
#> Warning: Column name 'time' (colClasses[[1]][1]) not found
#> INFO [2026-11-01 19:37:01] Structure 0003: nse 1
log_trial(folder, parent = 3, changes = c(surface.k1 = 3), verdict = "worse",
  reasoning = "Testing a slower first store")
#> Warning: Column name 'time' (colClasses[[1]][1]) not found
#> INFO [2026-11-01 19:37:01] Trial 0004 from 0003: nse 0.9995
project_trials(folder)
#>        id               type parent            timestamp        author
#>    <char>             <char> <char>               <char>        <char>
#> 1:   0003 structure_selected   <NA> 2026-11-01T19:37:01Z A Hydrologist
#> 2:   0004              trial   0003 2026-11-01T19:37:01Z A Hydrologist
#>              changes verdict                              reasoning       nse
#>               <char>  <char>                                 <char>     <num>
#> 1:                      <NA> Standard structure as a starting point 1.0000000
#> 2: surface.k1 2 -> 3   worse           Testing a slower first store 0.9995394
#>      log_nse      kge     kge_r kge_alpha  kge_beta         rmse     log_rmse
#>        <num>    <num>     <num>     <num>     <num>        <num>        <num>
#> 1: 1.0000000 1.000000 1.0000000  1.000000 1.0000000 8.692858e-15 3.102895e-15
#> 2: 0.9996688 0.995417 0.9997812  1.004578 0.9999963 2.543155e-02 8.173054e-03
#>     volume_error abs_volume_error    peak_error      fdc_high      fdc_mid
#>            <num>            <num>         <num>         <num>        <num>
#> 1: -1.110223e-15     1.110223e-15 -6.439294e-15 -3.434900e-15  4.25082e-16
#> 2: -3.705089e-06     3.705089e-06  2.608090e-03  3.898185e-03 -1.49071e-03
#>          fdc_low
#>            <num>

options(old)
unlink(folder, recursive = TRUE)
